## 8. JT Pay and Reckoning JT for increment  
Joining Time Pay.1. Joining time is regarded as duty and pay equal to the pay drawn before relinquishment of charge in the old post is admissible during joining time. In addition, Dearness Allowance appro priate to the pay and House Rent Allowance as applicable to the old headquarters, are admissible. - Rule 7.  
Permanent Travelling Allowance and Conveyance Allowance are not  
admissible during joining time. - Rule 7.
